name: Turkiye
dossier:
The Turkiye national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Ay-Yıldızlılar, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 22 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

A thrilling new generation led by two of Europe's brightest teenagers.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Turkiye will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group D and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group D. The connection between Arda Güler and Kenan Yıldız is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Arda Güler - the clinical playmaker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Turkiye are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Turkiye's 2002 third-place run included the fastest goal in World Cup history  -  10.8 seconds.
Turkiye boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Third place (2002).
